description:
BoboMimi — One Earth. Every Sense. Everyone.

Team BoboMimi is two colleagues from Bintulu, Malaysia, taking on The Earth Information Jukebox challenge. Our project, TerraJuke, turns NASA Earth visualizations into multisensory experiences that can be heard, seen, read and felt, so that Earth science is accessible to everyone.

We welcome collaborators with experience in accessibility, sound design, data visualization and science communication.
